cohort: 94 women with uterine anomalies who delivered after 22 gestational weeks
finding: Women with uterine anomalies classified by the number of uterine endometrial cavities and external uterine orifices have higher risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, such as cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and placental abruption.
mod_finding: Women with two external uterine orifices (didelphic or complete septate uterus) had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to the control group.
